name: figures
description: Draw diagrams, LaTeX math, and tool-result images inline in kitty-graphics terminals

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Diagram theme; auto follows Claude Code's light or dark theme. modern is mmdr-only, and mmdc draws it as default

background.title: Background
background.description: Diagram background color; transparent lets the terminal background show through

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Pixel density of the rendered picture; above 1 needs resvg on PATH, otherwise mmdr renders at 1x

cell_width_px.title: Cell width (px)
cell_width_px.description: Assumed width of one terminal cell, in the CSS pixels diagrams are laid out in

cell_aspect.title: Cell aspect
cell_aspect.description: Assumed height-to-width ratio of one terminal cell

max_columns.title: Max columns
max_columns.description: Widest a picture may be, in cells

max_rows.title: Max rows
max_rows.description: Tallest a picture may be, in cells

tool_images.title: Tool result images
tool_images.description: Draw images found in tool results, such as Read on an image file or a browser screenshot

renderers.title: Renderers
renderers.description: Renderer ids in preference order, comma-separated: mmdr, mmdc (mermaid), dot, d2, svg, mathjax. A lang with any of its renderers listed uses only those; others keep the default order

tool_image_max_rows.title: Tool image max rows
tool_image_max_rows.description: Tallest an image from a tool result may be, in cells; kept small so screenshots do not crowd out the conversation
